coverage.member: FusionSlider(this InputBoundField<TModel, TProp> setup, Action<SliderBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionSlider builder stops rendering the slider bound to the model value (the test asserts the temperature slider opens at aria-valuenow=68 with the visible reading 68°F carried over from last month)
the Change event stops firing the reactive handler as the resident nudges the handle, so the live reading and comfort note never update while the slider moves
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the slider's change event to its plan pipeline, so nudging the handle runs no reaction and the reading stays at 68
the change event arg contract stops delivering the payload into the plan, so neither the reading (Text) nor the comfort-zone branch (Value) can update when the handle moves
Value stops carrying the slider's new value into the comfort-zone condition (the test nudges to 70 and asserts the mid-range message that the >=66 branch over args.Value selects)
Text stops carrying the formatted slider value into the live reading (the test nudges to 70 and asserts the reading reads 70 from args.Text)
the Changed event stops firing when the handle settles, so the settle note (what it changed from, and how) never updates
PreviousValue stops carrying the value before the change (the test nudges the carried-over 68 up and asserts the settle note records the prior 68)
Action stops carrying the Syncfusion change-action name (the test nudges the handle and asserts the settle note labels the source 'changed')

IsInteracted stops distinguishing a temperature the resident chose (true -> 'You set this temperature yourself') from one applied for them (false -> 'recommended by your care team'); the test asserts both messages in sequence after a nudge then an Apply

coverage.member: SetValue(this ComponentRef<FusionSlider, TModel> self, double value)
coverage.catches: SetValue stops writing the given value onto the slider and repainting it (the test clicks Apply and asserts the handle moves to aria-valuenow=72)
the Value source stops reading the slider's current value into the guidance condition (the test raises the temperature to 74 and asserts the >=74 branch shows the overnight-check warning)

coverage.member: SetRangeValue(this ComponentRef<FusionSlider, TModel> self, double start, double end)
coverage.catches: SetRangeValue stops writing both range handles (the test clicks Apply and asserts the two handles move to aria-valuenow 14 and 16)
the RangeValue source stops reading the written range back out (the test asserts the saved summary reads '14,16' after Apply)

acceptedFanout.reason: one user gesture (nudging the temperature handle up one step) with DISTINCT fails-when-broken assertions per member: the live reading becoming 70 (FusionSliderChangeArgs.Text), the comfort-zone message selected by the value branch (FusionSliderChangeArgs.Value), and the reaction running at all (the Change event firing / the Reactive wiring connecting / the FusionSliderChangeArgs payload being delivered). Each member has its own assertion or its own observable failure mode in this test, not one assertion claimed for many members.
